Grimsby startup receives funding boost, local MP says

KeelLine, a Grimsby startup, has raised funding in a successful pre-seed round, the local MP said in a newsletter published on Friday.

The MP welcomed the investment for the town's tech sector and named KeelLine as the recipient, though the amount involved was not disclosed.

Local councillors described the move as a vote of confidence in the region's growing cluster of seafood-technology firms based around the town's docks.
